authored_scope: Supported: motif sides 3..6, where 5 and 6 are synthetic extensions beyond the fixtures. Pattern scales 1..3 with scale < motif side; scale 3 is synthetic. Block layouts of 2..6 x 2..8, limited to what fits in 30x30. Fill colour C is any colour except 0, 2 and 8. Pieces are placed anywhere on the canvas, separated by black cells including diagonals. Explicit arguments are honoured and validated; any subset of piece positions can be pinned. Not supported: motif accent colours other than 8 or motif base colours other than 2 (these are fixed roles), non-square motifs, non-integer pattern scales, single-row or single-column block layouts in random mode, and pieces touching each other.
authored_constraints: Motif is square and contains both 2 and 8 and nothing else; it is the only piece with colour 2.
Pattern contains both 8 and C, so the layout is neither empty nor full.
Scale f < m, so the rectangle (bh*bw*m^2 cells) is strictly the largest component.
All three pieces are separated by at least one black cell, diagonals included, so they form exactly three components under 4- or 8-connectivity.
All pieces lie within the grid; grid sides are at most 30.
Placement uses bounded retries plus a randomised stacked fallback that fits by construction; incompatible explicit arguments raise ValueError.
